environment.description: ASP.NET Core 8 service deployed on ECS Fargate in an isolated private subnet (no NAT, no IGW). Service is exposed exclusively through a VPC Endpoint Service (AWS PrivateLink) with com.amazonaws.vpce.us-east-1.vpce-svc-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890 as the service name. The endpoint service has 'Acceptance Required' enabled, meaning only pre-approved AWS accounts (listed in the allowed principals) can create interface endpoints to reach the service. The NLB target group performs TLS passthrough to the ECS tasks. Security groups on the ECS tasks restrict inbound to port 443 from the VPC CIDR 10.0.0.0/16 only. There is no public DNS record; consumers resolve via the VPC endpoint's private DNS (inventory.internal.corp). The VPC has no internet gateway, no NAT gateway, and no VPC peering to any VPC with internet access. Route tables for the subnet contain only local routes (10.0.0.0/16) and the PrivateLink ENI routes.

config.network: no IGW, no NAT, no peering to internet-connected VPCs
config.dns: private hosted zone inventory.internal.corp, no public record
config.database: RDS SQL Server in same VPC, private subnet
